title: hieracium carpathicum subsp. gemellum
intro: Hieracium carpathicum subsp. gemellum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a flowering plant species within the dandelion-like Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as inflammation, digestive problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium carpathicum subsp. gemellum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
